ch0.heading: How team chat works
ch0.bullet1: Only your own team can see what you write here.
ch0.bullet2: Something feel off? You can report a message, or block someone so you don't see any more of their messages.
ch0.bullet3: Some words don't work here. If a message won't send, try rewriting it.

ch2.heading: Why are you reporting this message?

ch3.heading: Thanks for telling us.
ch3.body: We've received your report. You don't need to do anything else — and no one will know it was you who reported it.
ch3.followUp: Do you also want to stop seeing messages from this person?

ch4.body: If you block {{screenName}}, you'll stop seeing their messages in the team chat and their Shorts in the Shorts feed. {{screenName}} won't know you've blocked them.

ch5.heading: Blocked teammates
ch5.headingSub: A block applies to both the team chat and Shorts.
ch5.unblockedToast: You can see messages from {{screenName}} again.
